_note: SYNTHETIC DATA. Scripted resolutions for POST /demo/replay ('replay 3 weeks', SPEC §18 beat 3). Dates are days after the demo clock. They mature the E1 lesson learned live from tentative to established.

records.request: anchor bolts for the press shop
records.what_happened: ISO 9001 certificate expired 5 days before the request; surveillance audit already done; vendor in good standing.
records.why: the vendor check blocks the vendor outright, but the lapse was administrative and the vendor was otherwise in good standing.
records.outcome: renewed certificate received in 4 days; PO released.
records.lesson: a recently expired certificate is a hold, not a rejection, when the vendor is otherwise in good standing.
